questions.question: Identify which teaching-material sets are meant by the alignment with the 2010 Federal State Educational Standards and add titles or editions if needed. The 2001 anthology is a separate book, and Gleizer’s role as compiler is retained.

localizations.source: Identify which teaching-material sets are meant by the alignment with the 2010 Federal State Educational Standards and add titles or editions if needed. The 2001 anthology is a separate book, and Gleizer’s role as compiler is retained.
localizations.ru: Уточнить, к каким именно учебно-методическим комплектам относятся слова о соответствии ФГОС-2010; при необходимости добавить названия и издания. Хрестоматия 2001 года — отдельная книга, её составительский статус сохранён.
